headlines.title: Ex-military chief Gadi Eisenkot, opponent of Netanyahu, tapped to form government
headlines.summary: The former military chief has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible extension of up to 14 more. If he fails, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is likely to get his chance.

headlines.title: New Zealand’s election results are too close to call
headlines.summary: Both Christopher Luxon of the National Party and Chris Hipkins of the opposition Labour Party admitted it was not yet clear who New Zealand's next leader would be.

headlines.title: Despite midterm rebuke of Trump, allies see U.S. turning further away
headlines.summary: U.S. allies are not celebrating Trump's midterm defeat, viewing the election results instead as another worrisome sign of a fickle electorate and unreliable partner.

headlines.title: Why Bolsonaro says U.S. took him in: Trump ‘convinced’ Brazil is no longer a democracy
headlines.summary: After losing an election, sneaking to Miami and proclaiming himself rightful president, Flávio Bolsonaro says in an interview that the U.S. is a refuge where “institutions still work.”

headlines.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of ‘incitement,’ handed 4-year sentence
headlines.summary: Tundu Lissu was acquitted of treason charges in a trial that rights groups said was meant to silence opposition to Tanzania’s government.

headlines.title: US moves to block Iran land supply routes; UAE rescues 22 from burning ship
headlines.summary: Iranian state media report blasts on Qeshm Island in Strait of Hormuz and the cities of Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas.

headlines.title: Israel’s president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form next government
headlines.summary: Isaac Herzog formally gives Gadi Eisenkot 28 days to secure 61 Knesset seats and replace Netanyahu as prime minister.

headlines.title: US launches task force to disrupt Iran’s land-based supply routes
headlines.summary: The operation is to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport weapons and other materials, US says.

headlines.title: Earthquake hits central Japan, injuring more than 20 people
headlines.summary: The magnitude 5.7 quake hit Shizuoka prefecture, and authorities warn of possible strong aftershocks in coming days.

headlines.title: Drone attack on Colombian army base kills three soldiers and wounds 16
headlines.summary: Colombian President de la Espriella says those behind the attack in Santa Rosa del Sur will have ‘nowhere to hide’.

headlines.title: UFC's Dana White says he will meet with Trump Monday over offer to be White House press secretary
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White.

headlines.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
headlines.summary: Homelessness declined after years of record-high levels but it still remains at nearly 700,000. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups cite different reasons for the drop.

headlines.title: The surprising and often forgotten history of economic populism in Texas
headlines.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Austin-based political commentator David Griscom. He authored a book titled The Myth of Red Texas which tells the story of economic populism in Texas.

headlines.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
headlines.summary: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.

headlines.title: Polish gunman who killed 6 people in Krakow has 'ultranationalistic' views, authorities say
headlines.summary: A gunman targeted random people as he drove into Krakow's Main Square, a major tourist spot. Police shot and wounded the gunman during a gunfight.

headlines.title: Major changes in US foreign policy 'unlikely'
headlines.summary: As a decisive blue wave sweeps the United States in the midterm elections, with the Democrats winning clear majorities in both the Senate and the House of Representatives, analysts expect stronger scrutiny of the administration led by US President Donald Trump, but noted that the shift in congressional power may not necessarily effect major changes in the US' foreign policy.

headlines.title: Trump touts 'big' Ukraine deal after meeting Russian envoy
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON -- US President Donald Trump said Thursday that "a big agreement" to end the Russia-Ukraine conflict could be reached soon and might involve all of Europe.

headlines.title: Japan's defense spending surge raises concerns
headlines.summary: As Japan faces mounting economic and fiscal pressures, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's administration is considering nearly doubling defense spending over the next five years, a move analysts warn could heighten regional tensions and further strain household budgets.

headlines.title: Turkish parliament approves Mecca Joint Defense Agreement with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia
headlines.summary: The General Assembly of the Grand National Assembly of Türkiye on Thursday approved a bill on the ratification of the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement among Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, local media reported.

headlines.title: UN warns global adaptation efforts lag behind escalating climate risks
headlines.summary: As climate change intensifies, exposing communities and economies to increasingly severe floods, droughts, and extreme heat, global efforts to adapt are struggling to keep pace, according to a new United Nations report.

headlines.title: Lucknow-bound IndiGo flight returns to Bengaluru after hijack threat note found onboard
headlines.summary: IndiGo flight 6E-451 returns to Bengaluru after a hijack-threat note found onboard; security checks reveal it as a hoax.

headlines.title: PM Modi conveys Deepavali greetings, says will celebrate the festival with soldiers
headlines.summary: PM Modi greets Diwali, pledges to celebrate with soldiers, though details of the post remain undisclosed.

headlines.title: Activists urge President to ensure no more election held using SIR list
headlines.summary: PASIR urges President to end SIR-based elections, intensifies protests, and calls for electoral reforms, accountability, and a nationwide campaign.

headlines.title: ‘Arrangements in place for festive rush,’ Railway Minister says
headlines.summary: Railway Minister Vaishnaw reports a proactive festive rush plan with live crowd dashboards, extra trains, and track upgrades across 28 stations.

headlines.title: PM Modi to celebrate Deepavali with forces in Bastar that was once den of Maoists
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Modi to celebrate Deepavali with security forces in Bastar, once Maoist-dominated, now flourishing with development.

hackerNews.title: Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi
hackerNews.summary: I’ve been a longtime Claude Code user, ever since it became available in the Claude Pro subscription plan over a year ago. I remember the first time I used it, feeling giddy as it spat out messy Python code for whatever random weekend project I was working on, all from a single prompt. I’m certain that in a few years we’ll all look back at its release as one of the major drivers of this new era of software development we’re in.

hackerNews.title: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
hackerNews.summary: Every Mac since macOS 13 (2022) ships a pair of daemons whose only purpose in life is to build a graph about who you are, who you know, how those people are related to you and to each other, how you communicate with them, where you go, what you do and when. In this post, we look into how this system works and give you a tool to peek into your own graph.
